mortgage_term.description: The term of the mortgage in years

description:
Dear Ms. Rivera,

I’m writing to confirm the details of the home purchase we discussed. The property is listed at $350,000, and I plan to make a down‑payment of $70,000. Based on a 30‑year mortgage term at an annual interest rate of 3.75 %, the loan figures should align with our preliminary calculations.

Please let me know if any additional documentation is required or if there are adjustments to be made before we proceed with the application. Thank you for your assistance.
